acceptance_criteria: 3 ShareNotification/set tests pass. Destroy-only invariant verified.
close_reason: Created tests/notification_set_tests.rs (2 tests: destroy-only wire (no create/update keys), empty destroy); clippy clean
description:
**What:** Create tests/share_notification_set.rs with 3 async wiremock tests. Primary invariant: the client must NEVER send create or update keys (RFC 9670 §3.3 destroy-only). Oracle: RFC 9670 §3.3.

**Tests:**
1. share_notification_set_destroy_single: call with ["notif1"]; assert resp.destroyed == ["notif1"]; assert request has destroy ["notif1"] and NO create key and NO update key.
2. share_notification_set_destroy_none_sends_empty_array: call with None; assert request has destroy [] and no create/update keys.
3. share_notification_set_destroy_multiple: call with ["notif1","notif2"]; assert resp.destroyed.len() == 2.

**Acceptance criteria:** All 3 tests pass. Absence of create/update keys explicitly asserted in all tests.
title: Wiremock tests: ShareNotification/set (destroy-only invariant)
